paper_title: Sparse Euclidean Spanners with Optimal Diameter: A General and Robust Lower Bound via a Concave Inverse-Ackermann Function
classifications: Theory of computation → Sparsification and spanners
statement: ▶ Question 1.1. Is there a lower bound of k versus Ω(nαk (n)) between the diameter and the number of edges, for all k, for Euclidean (1 + ϵ)-spanners?
context: In SoCG’22 Le et al. [38] gave the following suboptimal lower bound tradeoff, for (1 + ϵ)- n spanners of the uniform line metric: k versus Ω( 26⌊k/2⌋ αk (n)). While the result of [38] is tight for constant k, the following question remains open for more than three decades: ▶ Question 1.1. Is there a lower bound of k versus Ω(nαk (n)) between the diameter and the number of edges, for all k, for Euclidean (1 + ϵ)-spanners? SoCG 2023 1.1.2.1 Putting Question 1.1 into perspective.
